checks.name: A/B LONG: the entry fill carries slippage against the book
A/B LONG: the trade PnL matches the hand computation
A/B LONG: the final cash matches the hand computation
A/B LONG: the fee was CHARGED (not credited)
A LONG: a rising price makes the long PROFIT
A/B SHORT: the entry fill carries slippage against the book
A/B SHORT: the trade PnL matches the hand computation
A/B SHORT: the final cash matches the hand computation
A/B SHORT: the fee was CHARGED (not credited)
B SHORT: a falling price makes the short PROFIT
B SHORT: the mark-to-market of a short is a LIABILITY (the equity falls when the price rises)
C LONG: a bar touching stop AND target exits at the STOP
C SHORT: a bar touching stop AND target exits at the STOP
D LONG: the gap-through stop fills AT THE OPEN
D LONG: the exit is the stop
D SHORT: the gap-through stop fills AT THE OPEN
D SHORT: the exit is the stop
E: a gap at ENTRY is NOT skipped (the repo fills it at the open)
E: the entry gap fills AT THE OPEN
E: the pack's own mode DOES skip it (that is one of the declared differences)
F LONG: a positive funding rate has the RIGHT sign (pays)
F SHORT: a positive funding rate has the RIGHT sign (receives)
G: final equity - initial equity == sum(pnl) - funding, on every synthetic case
G: a broken ledger makes the metrics RAISE
H: the pack's mode folds its cost into the fill price
H: the pack's mode charges its cost AGAIN as a fee
H: the pack's effective cost is 1.1 bps round trip, ten times cheaper than the repo's 11 bps
